forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M5471KWH1N004TX9SSS7D38M
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: 8d80
+title: 'T1 follow-up b8: submission, answer and session core suites close each session, also when the body throws'
+---
+Source: task ^dbr1dqy (T1 audit, done). The audit left "tests that never close their session or router at all (about 60 suites)" out of scope. A new check on 2026-10-17 found 107 suites with tests that make a RoutedSession and never close it. `Router` has no `close()`; only `RoutedSession` does, so this group is about sessions only. This card has the submission, answer and session core suites.
+
+Rule T1: each wait in a test must also end on the failure event (run settle, session close, stream end), or the test must fail before it waits. A fixture closes also when the test body throws.
+Exception rule: first use an event that already exists (the session closes, the run settles, the feed ends). A hook only in test helpers is permitted. Do not change production code only for a test hook. When a case needs such a change, bring it to the coordinating session (swissarmyhammer-96) before you change it. Do not use `.timeLimit`, sleep, poll or retry. Run the full suite one time.
+Work rules: do the work in one agent. Do not run parallel agents on the tree. Edit files only with the edit tool. Do not run swift format.
+
+How to close (use the forms that T1 added):
+- Put `defer { await <session>.close() }` right after the session is made, for each session the test makes (root, fork). With gates, open the gates before the close (`SessionFixtureLifecycle.close(_:opening:)`, Helpers/SessionFixtureLifecycle.swift:83). `close()` is idempotent.
+- The `AnswerCancellationTests` fixtures (`Fixtures.makeFixture` + `fixture.profile.standard.makeSession`) do not close. Add the close at each test, or one `end()` on the fixture.
+- Local `makeFixture` / `runAnswer` / `deliveryPrompt` helpers do not close. Close inside the helper or give the fixture an `end()`; use `RouterTestFixtures.removingDirectoryOnThrow(_:alsoOnThrow:_:)` (Helpers/RouterTestFixtures.swift:156) for the throw path.
+- A close ends open answer streams, feeds and held submissions. Where a test cancels a held answer, check that the close in the `defer` comes after the gate opens, so the close does not wait on a held gate.
+- After a close, a test that waits on a feed now ends on the feed end. Check that no test now passes only because a wait ends early.
+
+Suites (file under Tests/FoundationModelsRouterTests/; the tests that never close):
+- [ ] AnswerCancellationTests, AnswerCancellationTests.swift: all 6.
+- [ ] AnswerCancellationTests extension, AnswerCancellationEntryPointTests.swift: all 9.
+- [ ] SessionAnswerTests, SessionAnswerTests.swift: 5 of 11 (answerReplyEqualsRespondForTheSameScriptedToolScript, plainRespondStillReturnsTheStringAnswer, observingDeliversTheRawEvents, answerCarriesToolCallsAndInvocationRecords, answerReplyEqualsRespondAndTheProjectionTextRow).
+- [ ] SubmissionAnswerEventTests, SubmissionAnswerEventTests.swift: 4 of 6 (anAnswerNamesEveryMessageOfItsSubmission, anAnswerNamesAMessageThatJoinedAContinuation, aFailedChainSendsAnswerFailedWithTheError, aRespondWhoseCallerCancelsThrowsCancellationError).
+- [ ] MultiMessageSessionTests, MultiMessageSessionTests.swift: all 3.
+- [ ] SessionChokepointTests, SessionChokepointTests.swift: all 8.
+- [ ] SessionEventStreamTests, SessionEventStreamTests.swift: all 11.
+- [ ] SessionMessagePumpTests, SessionMessagePumpTests.swift: all 11.
+- [ ] RespondRunPlaneDrainTests, RespondRunPlaneDrainTests.swift: all 9 (local deliveryPrompt). Note: T1 listed "close on throw" for this file; the check found no close on the success path.
+- [ ] SurfaceParityTests, SurfaceParityTests.swift: all 1 (local runAnswer).
+- [ ] SessionConfigurationTests, SessionConfigurationTests.swift: 4 of 13 (emptyConfigurationMatchesZeroArgumentMakeSession, configuredValueMatchesNineParameterCall, recordingRootReachesTheVendedSession, grammarConfigurationMatchesMakeGuidedSession).
+- [ ] SessionPromptCacheKeyTests, SessionPromptCacheKeyTests.swift: 2 of 5 (aForkAndItsParentUseTwoKeys, aCompactionKeepsTheKeyOfTheSession).
+- [ ] SessionRunPlaneTests, SessionRunPlaneTests.swift: 1 of 5 (forkGetsFreshRunPlane).
+- [ ] PendingEventInjectionTests, PendingEventInjectionTests.swift: 4 of 10 (emptyOutboxIsNoOp, pendingCompletedEventBecomesPreambleAndSegment, drainedEventDoesNotReappearNextAnswer, multiplePendingEventsPreserveOutboxOrder).
+- [ ] Run the full suite one time (`swift test`). Record the counts in a comment. #t1-followup
\ No newline at end of file
